column1: init|openrc,systemd|Active init system. Both ship in every package; the operator chooses.
tls|none,selfsigned,provided|API TLS mode. Selfsigned generates at apply time; provided uses operator cert/key.
credentials|interactive|Admin secrets are prompted at apply time and never stored.
db_node|controller|Database lands on a controller node.
mq_node|controller|Message queue lands on a controller node.
ha|none|High-availability mode. The HA stack is pending.
